mapper.select: SELECT id, instrument_id, jangdan_id, title, description, difficulty, default_bpm, score_json, score_version, umulsai_text, note_count, source, is_scorable, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM songs WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND instrument_id = #{instrumentId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, instrument_id, jangdan_id, title, description, difficulty, default_bpm, score_json, score_version, umulsai_text, note_count, source, is_scorable, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM songs WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, instrument_id, jangdan_id, title, description, difficulty, default_bpm, score_json, score_version, umulsai_text, note_count, source, is_scorable, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM songs WHERE id = #{id} AND score_version = #{scoreVersion} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT v.song_id AS id, v.instrument_id, v.jangdan_id, v.title, v.description, v.difficulty, v.default_bpm, v.score_json, v.score_version, v.umulsai_text, v.note_count, v.source, v.is_scorable, v.status, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.deleted_at FROM song_score_versions v JOIN songs s ON s.id = v.song_id WHERE v.song_id = #{id} AND v.score_version = #{scoreVersion} AND s.score_version <> v.score_version AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
